items.html: It has also been explained that when the Mochin of Gadlut enter the head of Zeir Anpin, the Mochin of Katnut are pushed downward; but nevertheless their illumination ascends upward, from below to above. Thus it is found that from all three aspects of the aforementioned Mochin, there grow in the head of Zeir Anpin: the barbs (Kutzin), which are strong, issue from the Mochin of the Ibur; the locks (Nimin), which are softer, are from the Mochin of the time of suckling; and the hairs (Se'arot), which are the softest of all, are from the Mochin of Gadlut.
